component.name: SoundTouch Controller
component.summary: Manage SoundTouch speakers connected through PipeWire

description.p: SoundTouch Controller displays speakers, saved multiroom zones, stereo pairs, observed hardware topology, and recent operations provided by the soundtouch-pipewire companion daemon.
It follows the daemon over a versioned session D-Bus API and can open a general PipeWire mixer for ordinary stream and volume controls.
